# TX Safety Supply

> > Texas-based industrial safety equipment and janitorial supply distributor serving the DFW area and beyond.

TX Safety Supply offers a comprehensive range of workplace safety products including PPE from trusted brands like Howard Leight, MSA, Portwest, and Swift First Aid, along with janitorial supplies from Georgia Pacific and Boardwalk. The company specializes in OSHA-compliant safety equipment, hearing protection, hi-vis clothing, first aid supplies, and facility maintenance products at wholesale prices.

## Key Topics

- Howard Leight hearing protection
- NRR (Noise Reduction Rating)
- OSHA compliance
- Portwest hi-vis safety vests
- MSA hard hats
- Swift First Aid supplies
- Georgia Pacific paper towels
- Boardwalk janitorial products
- GP 28143 towel dispensers
- Personal protective equipment (PPE)
- Workplace safety equipment
- Industrial safety supplies
- Facility maintenance supplies
- DFW area distributor
- Wholesale safety products
